en.summary: This commit finishes the MSHR response-ID width cleanup by passing NMshrEntry into the bundle constructor, but the surrounding code still does not show a concrete DUT-behavior fix. It is better treated as interface consistency cleanup than as a verified hardware bug fix for fault injection.
why_it_counts: Touches the core L1 MSHR hardware module.
Aligns a constructor argument with the intended entry-count semantics.
disqualifiers: The patch is a one-line constructor-argument cleanup following the previous width-definition change, not a self-contained control or data-path repair.
The refill producer already emits only log2Up(NMshrEntry) source bits and the MSHR consumer already reduces the value to an entry index, so a user-visible behavior change is not demonstrated.
No added test or nearby functional logic change shows that miss completion was incorrect before this standalone commit.
evidence: L1MSHR.scala changes missRspIn from new MSHRmissRspIn(bABits) to new MSHRmissRspIn(NMshrEntry).
The same file already defines MSHRmissRspIn.instrId as UInt(log2Up(NEntry).W) after the previous commit.
DCache.scala already slices d_source to SetIdxBits+log2Up(NMshrEntry)-1 downto SetIdxBits before driving missRspIn.bits.instrId.
The internal selector entryMatchMissRsp remains declared as UInt(log2Up(NMshrEntry).W).

zh.summary: 该提交通过把 NMshrEntry 传给 bundle 构造参数来收尾 MSHR 响应 ID 位宽整理，但结合周边代码，仍然看不出明确的 DUT 行为级修复。相比真实硬件 bug fix，它更适合被视为接口一致性清理。
why_it_counts: 修改发生在核心 L1 MSHR 硬件模块中。
补丁让构造参数与设计上期望的表项数语义对齐。
disqualifiers: 这只是继前一个位宽定义修改之后的一行构造参数清理，不是完整的控制或数据路径修复。
回填响应生产侧本来就只发出 log2Up(NMshrEntry) 位的 source，而 MSHR 消费侧本来也会把该值收敛成表项索引，因此没有证明存在用户可见的行为差异。
补丁没有新增测试，也没有相邻功能逻辑改动来证明在这个独立提交之前 miss 完成行为是错误的。
evidence: L1MSHR.scala 把 missRspIn 从 new MSHRmissRspIn(bABits) 改成了 new MSHRmissRspIn(NMshrEntry)。
在同一个文件里，前一个提交之后 MSHRmissRspIn.instrId 已经被定义成 UInt(log2Up(NEntry).W)。
DCache.scala 在驱动 missRspIn.bits.instrId 之前，已经把 d_source 切到了 SetIdxBits+log2Up(NMshrEntry)-1 到 SetIdxBits 这一段。
内部选择器 entryMatchMissRsp 的声明仍然是 UInt(log2Up(NMshrEntry).W)。
